text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and your mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, regular exercise is important because it keeps your heart strong and helps you feel good. Third, don't forget sleep: most adults need about seven to eight hours every night. Mental health matters too, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. When work and rest are in harmony, you feel happier and more energetic every day.
